semantics.amounts: Each opportunity independently starts with100000 yuan; overlapping positive/negative sums are not a continuous account PnL.
semantics.labels: entry_net after buyfee may be observed before net after two fees and closure. Unfilled/right-censored labels remain missing, never zero-filled.
semantics.ratios: Selected/rejected amounts and signed observation counts divided by their label-specific group totals. Every all-group denominator uses the common431 feature_ready population; yearly/sign groups are explicit subpopulations, not new filters.
semantics.signal_returns: r1/r5 are completed signal-day adjusted close log changes; strictlypositive/strictlynegative/zero are separate. Outcomes remain T+1 actual entry and three-session event outcomes.
semantics.selection: Mean was selected after EX055 outcomes. This diagnosis uses the same repeatedly seen development sample and is not independent confirmation.
semantics.execution: EX026 event labels allow one buy attempt; account cycle retries and capital ownership differ. No new account is computed or inferred.
